presets._comment: Displayed frame-time tables; ARE/DAS are +2 here compared to internal game logic

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.help: Override the gravity curve while preserving soft drop, sonic drop and the game's forced-20G rules. The slider midpoint is 1G.

effective_gravity.label: Effective gravity
effective_gravity.help: Override the final falling speed, including soft drop, sonic drop and forced 20G. The slider midpoint is 1G.

are.label: ARE
are.help: Entry delay for the next piece. Changes take effect on the next entry transition.

line_are.label: Line ARE
line_are.help: Entry delay after a line clear.

line_clear.label: Line clear
line_clear.help: Line-clear animation counter loaded at the next clear.

lock.label: Lock delay
lock.help: Lock duration loaded for the next piece. The active countdown runs normally.

das.label: DAS
das.help: Threshold for held horizontal input; charge runs normally.

invisible.label: Stack visibility
invisible.help: Visible shows the stack. Invisible preserves M-roll lock flash and brief fade. Fading gives new locks the normal roll's 300-frame countdown (about 5 seconds). End-of-game reveal follows the game. Doubles shares one field; Player 1's setting takes precedence.

bypass_torikan.label: Bypass Death torikan
bypass_torikan.help: Skip the Death time-limit decision at its original check.

ghost.label: Ghost piece
ghost.help: Override the ghost visibility argument passed to the piece renderer.

mroll.label: M-roll qualification
mroll.help: Treat the native M-roll qualification bits as satisfied at their consumers. Does not forge your actual grade or section times.

freeze_level.label: Freeze level
freeze_level.help: Freeze the current level. Explicit level and section jumps remain available.

big.label: BIG pieces
big.help: Set or clear BIG for the opening preview and queued pieces in every mode. BIG pieces use the game's two-column movement grid and spawn alignment. The active piece keeps its size and movement grid until the next handoff.

items.label: ITEM mode
items.help: Keep item mode enabled or disabled at piece-generation events.
